examples.zh: 请稍等几分钟。

examples.zh: 几十名球迷在机场等候。

examples.zh: 销售数据看起来很有希望。

examples.zh: 她帮助过数不清的学生。

examples.zh: 成本的大头是人工。

examples.zh: 我平均每月读两本书。

examples.zh: 多达 500 名跑者参加了比赛。

examples.zh: 数据用量正在指数级增长。

examples.zh: 这款应用的用户呈指数级增长。

examples.zh: 周日公交班次稀少。

examples.zh: 该市旅游业实现了两位数增长。

examples.zh: 旅行之后我有点累。

examples.zh: 这场演出极受欢迎。

examples.zh: 去年价格大幅变动。

examples.en: The city has changed dramatically.
examples.zh: 这座城市发生了翻天覆地的变化。

examples.en: Test scores improved significantly.
examples.zh: 考试成绩显著提高。

examples.en: Two players, notably the captain, improved.
examples.zh: 两名队员明显进步,尤其是队长。

examples.zh: 爬山之后我彻底累垮了。

examples.zh: 延误有一部分是我的责任。

examples.zh: 我在一定程度上同意你的看法。

examples.en: The work is more or less finished.
examples.zh: 工作差不多完成了。

examples.en: The movie was kind of boring.
examples.zh: 这电影有点无聊。

examples.en: I'm sort of nervous about the test.
examples.zh: 我对这次考试有点紧张。

examples.en: This is by far the best cake in town.
examples.zh: 这显然是城里最好吃的蛋糕。

examples.en: It rained continuously for a week.
examples.zh: 雨连续下了一个星期。

examples.en: He continually checks his phone in class.
examples.zh: 他上课频频看手机。

examples.en: She repeatedly warned the swimmers.
examples.zh: 她反复警告游泳的人。

examples.en: We see our cousins now and again.
examples.zh: 我们偶尔会见见表亲。

examples.en: Every now and then I reread my notes.
examples.zh: 我时不时地重温笔记。

examples.en: Once in a while we eat out.
examples.zh: 我们偶尔下馆子。

examples.en: At times the queue moved very slowly.
examples.zh: 有时队伍挪动得很慢。

examples.en: From time to time she phones home.
examples.zh: 她时不时给家里打电话。

examples.en: He hardly ever arrives late.
examples.zh: 他几乎从不迟到。

examples.en: The school radically changed its timetable.
examples.zh: 学校彻底改革了作息表。

examples.en: The book profoundly affected my thinking.
examples.zh: 这本书深深影响了我的思考。

examples.en: The new phone is vastly better.
examples.zh: 新手机好了太多。

examples.en: Rents rose substantially this year.
examples.zh: 今年房租大幅上涨。

examples.en: Engineers worked around the clock.
examples.zh: 工程师们昼夜不停地工作。

examples.en: He cooks day in, day out for the family.
examples.zh: 他日复一日为全家做饭。

examples.en: Nine times out of ten she wins the game.
examples.zh: 她十有八九会赢这局。

examples.en: I studied for ten days in a row.
examples.zh: 我连续学习了十天。

examples.en: The match was cancelled and subsequently rearranged.
examples.zh: 比赛被取消,随后重新安排。

examples.en: Dinner is cooking; in the meantime, set the table.
examples.zh: 晚饭在做着;这期间你摆一下餐具。

examples.en: He moved to Leeds and settled there thereafter.
examples.zh: 他搬到利兹,此后便定居在那里。

examples.en: Prior to the meeting, read the report.
examples.zh: 开会之前先读一下报告。

examples.en: Subsequent events proved her right.
examples.zh: 随后发生的事证明她是对的。

examples.en: It rained for five consecutive days.
examples.zh: 连续下了五天雨。

examples.en: The bridge has a span of 200 metres.
examples.zh: 这座桥跨度为两百米。

examples.en: The festival is held annually in May.
examples.zh: 这个节日每年五月举行。

examples.en: The team meets quarterly to review goals.
examples.zh: 团队每季度开会复盘目标。

examples.en: The city changed overnight.
examples.zh: 这座城市一夜之间变了样。

examples.en: Sooner or later you will remember the word.
examples.zh: 迟早你会想起这个词。

examples.en: Reviewing daily pays off in the long run.
examples.zh: 从长远看,每天复习是值得的。

examples.en: She moved abroad, and from then on we wrote letters.
examples.zh: 她移居国外,从那时起我们靠书信联系。

examples.en: Up to now, no one has solved the puzzle.
examples.zh: 到现在为止,还没有人解开这个谜。

examples.en: List the events in chronological order.
examples.zh: 按时间顺序列出这些事件。

examples.en: The students read the poem in turn.
examples.zh: 学生们轮流朗读这首诗。

examples.en: The lights went out one by one.
examples.zh: 灯一盏接一盏地灭了。

examples.en: Follow the recipe step by step.
examples.zh: 一步一步照着食谱做。

examples.en: Little by little, her English improved.
examples.zh: 她的英语一点点进步了。

examples.en: The patient grew stronger day by day.
examples.zh: 病人一天天强壮起来。

examples.en: I instantly recognized her voice.
examples.zh: 我立刻听出了她的声音。

examples.en: The bus will arrive shortly.
examples.zh: 公交车很快就到。

examples.en: The manager spoke briefly to the team.
examples.zh: 经理对团队作了简短讲话。

examples.en: The gallery is temporarily closed.
examples.zh: 美术馆暂时闭馆。

examples.en: They moved permanently to Canada.
examples.zh: 他们永久移居加拿大。

examples.en: He says he has given up smoking for good.
examples.zh: 他说他已永远戒烟了。

examples.en: So far, so good.
examples.zh: 到目前为止一切顺利。

examples.en: The shop will be closed by then.
examples.zh: 到那时商店就关门了。

examples.en: We made many friends along the way.
examples.zh: 这一路上我们交了很多朋友。

examples.en: The summer passed in a flash.
examples.zh: 夏天转眼就过去了。

examples.en: The bridge is closed; hence the delay.
examples.zh: 大桥封闭,因此造成了延误。

examples.en: The data was lost; thus we started again.
examples.zh: 数据丢了,于是我们从头再来。

examples.en: She missed the train and consequently the meeting.
examples.zh: 她错过了火车,因此也错过了会议。

examples.en: Prices rose; wages were adjusted accordingly.
examples.zh: 物价上涨,工资也相应调整。

examples.en: He overslept; as a result, he missed the bus.
examples.zh: 他睡过了头,结果错过了公交。

examples.en: The flight was delayed owing to fog.
examples.zh: 由于大雾,航班延误了。

examples.en: Thanks to your help, I passed the test.
examples.zh: 多亏你的帮助,我通过了考试。

examples.en: Eating too much sugar leads to health problems.
examples.zh: 吃糖过多会导致健康问题。

examples.en: The internet brought about huge changes.
examples.zh: 互联网带来了巨大变化。

examples.en: Many fears stem from childhood.
examples.zh: 许多恐惧源于童年。

examples.en: The storm resulted in power cuts.
examples.zh: 暴风雨导致停电。

examples.en: The delay resulted from heavy traffic.
examples.zh: 延误是交通拥堵造成的。

examples.en: Poor storage gave rise to the smell.
examples.zh: 存放不当引起了异味。

examples.en: The win was down to team spirit.
examples.zh: 胜利要归功于团队精神。

examples.en: She attributes her success to daily practice.
examples.zh: 她把成功归因于每日练习。

examples.en: Don't blame the tool for your mistakes.
examples.zh: 别因为自己的失误而怪工具。

examples.en: He accepted the consequences of his choice.
examples.zh: 他承担了自己选择的后果。

examples.en: The outcome of the vote surprised analysts.
examples.zh: 投票结果让分析人士吃惊。

examples.en: The medicine had a positive effect.
examples.zh: 这种药效果很好。

examples.en: Social media has a big impact on teens.
examples.zh: 社交媒体对青少年影响很大。

examples.en: The weather affects my mood.
examples.zh: 天气影响我的心情。

examples.en: The news triggered a wave of comments.
examples.zh: 这则新闻引发了一波评论。

examples.en: Price was the deciding factor.
examples.zh: 价格是决定性因素。

examples.en: The underlying cause is still unknown.
examples.zh: 根本原因尚不清楚。

examples.en: Yoghurt is a by-product of milk processing.
examples.zh: 酸奶是牛奶加工的副产品。

examples.en: This medicine may cause side effects.
examples.zh: 这种药可能有副作用。

examples.en: The strike caused a chain reaction of delays.
examples.zh: 罢工引发了延误的连锁反应。

examples.en: Rail delays had a knock-on effect on schools.
examples.zh: 铁路延误对学校产生了连带影响。

examples.en: One closure started a domino effect on the street.
examples.zh: 一家店倒闭引发了整条街的连锁倒闭。

examples.en: The diagram shows cause and effect clearly.
examples.zh: 这张图清楚地展示了因果关系。

examples.en: He is quiet, whereas his sister is talkative.
examples.zh: 他很安静,而他姐姐很健谈。

examples.en: The task was hard; nonetheless, she finished it.
examples.zh: 任务很难,尽管如此她还是完成了。

examples.en: The plan was risky; nevertheless, they went ahead.
examples.zh: 计划有风险,然而他们还是推进了。

examples.en: It isn't cheaper — on the contrary, it costs more.
examples.zh: 并没有更便宜——恰恰相反,更贵了。

examples.en: In contrast, the north of the country is dry.
examples.zh: 相比之下,该国北部很干燥。

examples.en: Prices fell here; by contrast, they rose abroad.
examples.zh: 这里价格下降了;对比之下,国外却上涨了。

examples.en: The city is exciting; on the other hand, it is tiring.
examples.zh: 城市很热闹;另一方面也让人疲惫。

examples.en: Walk rather than drive to the shop.
examples.zh: 去商店走着去,别开车。

examples.en: She prefers tea, as opposed to coffee.
examples.zh: 与咖啡相比,她更喜欢茶。

examples.en: In spite of the rain, the match went on.
examples.zh: 尽管下雨,比赛仍继续进行。

examples.en: The map was old; even so, it helped.
examples.zh: 地图很旧,即便如此还是帮上了忙。

examples.en: Even though he was tired, he kept working.
examples.zh: 尽管很累,他仍继续工作。

examples.en: Apart from the ending, the film was great.
examples.zh: 除了结尾,这部电影很棒。

examples.en: He had no income other than his pension.
examples.zh: 除养老金外他没有别的收入。

examples.en: Happy workers stay longer; conversely, leaving hurts morale.
examples.zh: 快乐的员工留得久;反过来,离职会打击士气。

examples.en: Whilst I agree with the idea, the timing is wrong.
examples.zh: 尽管我赞同这个想法,但时机不对。

examples.en: Admittedly, the plan is not perfect.
examples.zh: 诚然,这个计划并不完美。

examples.en: Don't give up — it's your dream, after all.
examples.zh: 别放弃——这毕竟是你的梦想。

examples.en: The tickets were pricey, but we enjoyed it all the same.
examples.zh: 票很贵,但我们还是玩得很开心。

examples.en: The job is demanding; at the same time, it is rewarding.
examples.zh: 这份工作要求高,但同时也很有回报。

examples.en: The second hotel was cheaper in comparison.
examples.zh: 相比之下,第二家酒店更便宜。

examples.en: The test was relatively easy.
examples.zh: 这次测验相对容易。

examples.en: The car is comparatively cheap to run.
examples.zh: 这辆车使用成本比较低。

examples.en: On balance, moving house was the right choice.
examples.zh: 总的来说,搬家是对的。

examples.en: He's late again, mind you, so was everyone.
examples.zh: 他又迟到了,不过话说回来,大家都迟到了。

examples.en: The food is pricey; that said, it is worth it.
examples.zh: 食物不便宜;话虽如此,还是值得的。

examples.en: Rain or shine, we hike — either way, bring a jacket.
examples.zh: 下雨与否都去徒步——总之带件外套。

examples.en: The club welcomes all, regardless of age.
examples.zh: 俱乐部欢迎所有人,不论年龄。

examples.en: The results were far from satisfactory.
examples.zh: 结果远不能令人满意。

examples.en: Contrast the two photos carefully.
examples.zh: 仔细对比这两张照片。

examples.en: The flat is small; furthermore, it needs repairs.
examples.zh: 公寓很小,而且还需要修缮。

examples.en: Besides, we have no time to wait.
examples.zh: 再说,我们也没时间等。

examples.en: In addition, the ticket includes lunch.
examples.zh: 此外,门票还包含午餐。

examples.en: The bag is light; what is more, it is waterproof.
examples.zh: 这个包很轻,更重要的是还防水。

examples.en: The hotel lost our booking; on top of that, the lift was broken.
examples.zh: 酒店弄丢了我们的预订,雪上加霜的是电梯还坏了。

examples.zh: 她会法语和西班牙语,更不用说英语了。

examples.zh: 此外,学生可免费使用健身房。

examples.en: She sent flowers along with a card.
examples.zh: 她随卡片一起送了花。

examples.zh: 这趟旅行花费高昂,更不必说风险了。

examples.en: He can't swim, let alone dive.
examples.zh: 他不会游泳,更别说跳水了。

examples.en: Heavy rain, coupled with wind, closed the port.
examples.zh: 大雨加上大风,港口关闭了。

examples.en: She sold the house, together with the furniture.
examples.zh: 她把房子连同家具一起卖了。

examples.zh: 锻炼加上好睡眠让你保持健康。

examples.en: The school runs alongside the river.
examples.zh: 学校紧挨着河。

examples.en: Everyone smiled, including the driver.
examples.zh: 大家都笑了,包括司机。

examples.en: She not only sings but also plays the guitar.
examples.zh: 她不仅会唱歌,还会弹吉他。

examples.zh: 他靠夜校兼职补贴收入。

examples.en: The two methods are complementary.
examples.zh: 这两种方法是互补的。

examples.en: The wine complements the fish dish.
examples.zh: 这款酒与鱼料理相得益彰。

examples.en: They sell pens, paper, glue, and so on.
examples.zh: 他们卖笔、纸、胶水等等。

examples.en: The talk covered trade, among others.
examples.zh: 讲座内容涵盖贸易等多个话题。

examples.en: On top of his salary, he gets a travel allowance.
examples.zh: 除工资外,他还有差旅补贴。

examples.en: The teacher gave us supplementary reading lists.
examples.zh: 老师给了我们补充阅读书单。

examples.en: The instructions were exceedingly clear.
examples.zh: 说明写得极其清楚。

examples.en: The room was quiet and cheap into the bargain.
examples.zh: 房间安静,而且还便宜。

examples.en: Add walking into the mix for better health.
examples.zh: 再加入散步,健康会更好。

examples.en: By the way, the meeting moved to three.
examples.zh: 顺便说一句,会议改到三点了。

examples.en: Incidentally, the shop closes early on Sundays.
examples.zh: 顺便提一句,这家店周日提前打烊。

examples.en: She teaches English as well.
examples.zh: 她也教英语。

examples.en: The fee covers meals over and above the room.
examples.zh: 这笔费用除房费外还包含餐食。

examples.en: From my standpoint, the plan needs more time.
examples.zh: 在我看来,这个计划需要更多时间。

examples.en: He asserted that the data was wrong.
examples.zh: 他断言数据是错的。

examples.en: The report supports her assertion.
examples.zh: 报告支持她的论断。

examples.en: Critics contend the law is unfair.
examples.zh: 批评者主张该法律不公平。

examples.en: In my view, the first design is better.
examples.zh: 在我看来,第一个设计更好。

examples.en: From my perspective, the change is positive.
examples.zh: 从我的角度看,这个变化是积极的。

term: as far as I am concerned

examples.en: As far as I am concerned, the matter is closed.
examples.zh: 就我而言,这件事已经了结。

examples.en: To my mind, safety comes before speed.
examples.zh: 依我看,安全比速度更重要。

examples.en: Personally, I prefer trains to planes.
examples.zh: 就个人而言,我更喜欢坐火车而不是飞机。

examples.en: She pointed out an error in the bill.
examples.zh: 她指出账单上的一处错误。

examples.en: He left on the grounds of ill health.
examples.zh: 他以健康不佳为由离开了。

examples.en: There is no justification for such rudeness.
examples.zh: 如此无礼毫无道理可言。

examples.en: In conclusion, both plans have merit.
examples.zh: 总之,两个方案各有优点。

examples.en: Overall, the show was a success.
examples.zh: 总体来说,演出很成功。

examples.en: On the whole, customers like the new design.
examples.zh: 大体上,顾客喜欢新设计。

examples.en: Generally speaking, mornings are less crowded.
examples.zh: 一般来说,早上人少一些。

examples.en: Presumably, the delay was caused by snow.
examples.zh: 想必延误是降雪造成的。

examples.en: The seemingly simple task took hours.
examples.zh: 这个看似简单的任务花了好几个小时。

examples.en: Prices tend to rise before holidays.
examples.zh: 节前价格往往会上涨。

examples.en: I am inclined to agree with you.
examples.zh: 我倾向于同意你的看法。

examples.en: Many hold the view that taxes are too high.
examples.zh: 许多人认为税收太高了。

examples.en: Frankly, the service was disappointing.
examples.zh: 坦白说,服务令人失望。

examples.en: That is a valid point worth discussing.
examples.zh: 那是一个值得讨论的有力论点。

examples.en: Her argument was clear and convincing.
examples.zh: 她的论点清晰而有说服力。

examples.en: The ad uses persuasive language.
examples.zh: 这则广告使用了有说服力的语言。

meaning: adj. 令人信服的;扣人心弦的

examples.en: The film makes a compelling case for change.
examples.zh: 这部电影为变革提出了令人信服的理由。

examples.en: The plan is good but slightly flawed.
examples.zh: 这个计划不错,但略有缺陷。

examples.en: The argument rests on a false premise.
examples.zh: 这个论点建立在错误的前提上。

examples.en: The old notion no longer fits modern life.
examples.zh: 这种旧观念已不再适合现代生活。

examples.en: This is arguably the best café in town.
examples.zh: 这可以说是城里最好的咖啡馆。

examples.en: I disagree with the new rule.
examples.zh: 我不同意这条新规定。

examples.en: We are in agreement on the price.
examples.zh: 我们在价格上意见一致。

examples.en: I share the view that early saving matters.
examples.zh: 我和大家一样认为早点存钱很重要。

examples.en: You cannot publish the photo without consent.
examples.zh: 未经同意你不能发布这张照片。

examples.en: The manager approved my holiday request.
examples.zh: 经理批准了我的休假申请。

examples.en: The plan finally got board approval.
examples.zh: 该计划最终获得了董事会批准。

examples.en: My parents disapprove of too much screen time.
examples.zh: 我父母不赞成长时间看屏幕。

examples.en: The new tax met strong opposition.
examples.zh: 新税种遭到强烈反对。

examples.en: She is opposed to cutting the budget.
examples.zh: 她反对削减预算。

examples.en: Most voters are in favor of the library plan.
examples.zh: 大多数选民赞成图书馆计划。

meaning: adj. 支持的,给予帮助的

examples.en: My friends were supportive when I changed jobs.
examples.zh: 我换工作时朋友们很支持我。

examples.en: Several doctors endorsed the health campaign.
examples.zh: 几位医生公开支持这项健康活动。

examples.en: I will go along with your idea for now.
examples.zh: 我暂时赞同你的想法。

examples.en: In family rows, dad always sides with mom.
examples.zh: 家里争执时,爸爸总站在妈妈一边。

examples.en: The judges concurred with the original decision.
examples.zh: 法官们同意原来的裁决。

examples.en: He conceded that the critics were right.
examples.zh: 他承认批评者是对的。

examples.en: Both sides made small concessions.
examples.zh: 双方都做了一些小让步。

examples.en: We need to find middle ground on the price.
examples.zh: 我们需要在价格上找到折中点。

examples.zh: 异地恋需要信任。

examples.en: It was puppy love, sweet and brief.
examples.zh: 那是一段青涩又短暂的初恋。

meaning: adj. 纯友谊的,柏拉图式的

examples.en: Their platonic friendship lasts decades.
examples.zh: 他们纯友谊的关系持续了几十年。

examples.en: We cherish the years we lived by the sea.
examples.zh: 我们珍惜住在海边的那些年。

examples.zh: 双胞胎很早就进入了青春期。

examples.zh: 中年时他爱上了帆船。

examples.zh: 她直到晚年还养蜂。

examples.en: The grown-ups talked while we played.
examples.zh: 大人们聊天,我们玩耍。

examples.en: A middle-aged couple ran the inn.
examples.zh: 一对中年夫妇经营着客栈。

examples.en: The novel is a coming-of-age story.
examples.zh: 这部小说是一个成长故事。

examples.en: She travelled widely in her twenties.
examples.zh: 她二十几岁时游历四方。

examples.en: He bought the farm in his thirties.
examples.zh: 他三十几岁时买下了农场。

examples.en: Pensioners ride the tram free.
examples.zh: 领养老金的老人免费乘电车。

examples.en: Senior citizens get priority seating.
examples.zh: 老年人享有优先座位。

examples.zh: 他的中年危机只持续了一个夏天。

examples.zh: 仪式在破晓时分开始。

examples.zh: 她母亲死于分娩。

examples.zh: 迎婴聚会上挂满了小袜子。

examples.zh: 开学第一天总要有新鞋。

examples.zh: 为人父母改变了他们的旅行计划。

examples.en: They redid the garden in their empty nest years.
examples.zh: 空巢期他们重新打理了花园。

examples.zh: 退休人员在图书馆前台做志愿者。

examples.zh: 暮年时他以写信为乐。

examples.zh: 这张长椅是为纪念她的老师而设。

examples.zh: 这个艺术节已走向成熟。

examples.zh: 他们承诺白头偕老。

examples.zh: 登山者忽视了危险。

examples.zh: 延误使交易面临风险。

examples.zh: 散养狗对骑车人是种威胁。

examples.zh: 梯子摇摇欲坠地靠着。

examples.zh: 为防万一,带上一支手电。

examples.zh: 孩子们在甲板上要穿救生衣。

examples.zh: 安全气囊砰地弹开了。

examples.zh: 每月测试一次烟雾报警器。

examples.zh: 电梯旁挂着灭火器。

examples.zh: 消防演习十点整开始。

examples.en: Keep the emergency exit clear.
examples.zh: 请保持紧急出口畅通。

examples.en: The first aid kit lives under the seat.
examples.zh: 急救箱放在座位下面。

examples.zh: 每个角落都放着一个救生圈。

examples.en: The guardrail stopped the skid.
examples.zh: 护栏挡住了打滑的车。

examples.en: Hold the handrail on the stairs.
examples.zh: 上下楼梯请抓扶手。

examples.en: Lifeboats drill every Wednesday.
examples.zh: 救生艇每周三演练。

examples.zh: 黄昏时游艇发出了遇险信号。
